verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud ships an official, automatically-configured MCP server per project that lets AI interfaces (ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) interact with indexed data, confirmed both in docs and via a live probe of the docs page. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the MCP server's tool surface covering analytics and index-management operations (docs emphasize query/interaction but don't detail full CRUD/analytics tool coverage), and no third-party confirmation of real-world usage.
